After being a customer for years, I will never go to this veterinary clinic again.

I was a customer at this veterinary clinic for years, first with my dog ​​and later with my two cats. Although I already found the costs quite high at the time, my initial experiences were positive. The assistants and veterinarians were friendly, the pet shop next door was pleasant, and the clinic was close to home for me, which also meant less stress for my animals.

Unfortunately, in my experience, the quality of this clinic has deteriorated enormously over the years.

For instance, things went wrong several times with vaccination reminders. Reminders arrived too late or never came at all. When I pointed out myself that I had scheduled one of my animals for a vaccination, the reaction was irritably. According to the clinic, that couldn't be right, because otherwise I would have received a reminder automatically. Subsequently, I went to the vet and was told that *I* was too late and should have called earlier. A particularly contradictory and unprofessional state of affairs.

The way I and my animals have been treated lately also bothers me greatly. Where I used to experience involvement and love for animals, I now got a predominantly cold and businesslike impression. To me, a veterinarian should not only perform medical procedures but also treat an animal and its owner with attention, patience, and respect. Ultimately, I completely missed that involvement here.

The low point was the dental cleaning of my two cats. The final bill did not match the amount discussed with me beforehand at all. Additional costs kept being added, making the final amount, in my opinion, excessively high. Moreover, it later turned out that I could have spent hundreds of euros less for comparable care at another veterinarian.

As if that wasn't enough, one of my cats developed complications less than two weeks after the treatment. To my surprise, there was talk of performing another dental treatment immediately. Less than two weeks after the first treatment, it was essentially suggested to "just give it another try," resulting in significant costs once again. That has permanently destroyed my trust.

I have since switched to another veterinarian, and the difference is enormous for me. I do experience clear communication there, a commitment to my animals, and a service that makes me feel comfortable. In hindsight, I mainly regret not having switched sooner.

My experience with this clinic can ultimately be summarized as follows: high and, in my opinion, insufficiently transparent costs, contradictory communication, little personal involvement, staff I found rude, and veterinarians who seem to change frequently. Moreover, I increasingly got the feeling that financial interests outweighed the care and attention for my animals.

Having been a client for years, I am therefore not writing this because of a single unpleasant appointment. It is the result of an accumulation of negative experiences that has caused my trust to completely vanish.

I absolutely cannot recommend this veterinary clinic. I have had enough, and I will not be returning here.

DO NOT GO TO THIS VETERINARIAN!!!

I have had multiple incidents at this veterinary clinic that are simply unacceptable. They refer you elsewhere and write bills, nothing more!!

My previous cat was already a senior when I welcomed her into my home and heart, and this "veterinarian" referred her for something unnecessary to a much more expensive specialist where my cat, at the age of 16 with a heart problem, simply had to be put under anesthesia. This could have cost her her life! Fortunately, I was able to change the surgery at the specialist's into a consultation where he told me that the surgery was not necessary.

Two years later, when my cat suddenly stopped eating and I went to see if anything could be done, I was told that she could no longer be saved and I WAS SENT HOME WITH A CAT THAT WAS ACTIVELY DYING. They gave me some flyers for "euthanasia at home," where the people there also lacked tact and pressured me to make a choice immediately, while I was crying on the phone, begging for one hour to think it over.
If they recommend people like that, you can imagine for yourself what kind of people work there.

A fantastic veterinary clinic! From the very first moment, I felt that my dog ​​Hera was in good hands. The veterinarian and assistants were incredibly friendly, caring, and took all the time to answer my questions. The surgery went perfectly, and I received clear explanations regarding aftercare. That gave me a lot of confidence, especially since you want to leave your dog behind with peace of mind. I am enormously grateful for the professional and loving care Hera received. Highly recommended!
Excellent service. Very kind with dogs and speak english

Terrible Vet, part of a conglomerate that only cares about profit.
Service deteriorated over time, while prices went sky-high. What I mind most is that they employ very young staff that is not supervised by an experienced staff member. Feels like a supermarket.
Like so many others I took my pet elsewhere and haven't been back in years. Regardless they keep spamming your email. You can sign out or even block their email address, but in two months time they will use a different email address and the spam continues.

BE WARNED! Do not go here! There is no care for the animals and they are really only after the money. My dog ​​was here for the removal of 2 teeth and I was informed that it would cost around 150 to 200 euros. After the surgery, I received a call telling me I had to pick him up quickly because they wanted to close earlier that day and if I wasn't quick, he would stay there overnight. Upon picking him up, I was informed that 5 teeth had been removed and that it cost 970 euros!
Great service and very nice to the pets
I received extremely friendly, skillful, and helpful assistance in an emergency situation.
Always easy to interact and good experience
Satisfied with the service. Not with the prices; I think they are much too high.

I do not recommend this veterinary clinic.

I was a client for three years. However, the last year became extremely problematic when my cat became seriously ill. The vet referred me to a hospital that is about 40 minutes away. Later I discovered that both this clinic and the hospital belong to the same corporate investment group (Evidensia). This was never explained to me, even though there are many veterinary hospitals in Amsterdam.

The hospital could not make a diagnosis. I had to do my own research and asked to be referred to MCD. MCD finally diagnosed my cat with FIP and prescribed a treatment that requires daily medication for 120 days.

MCD sent the medical report to this clinic and asked them to order the medication monthly. The veterinarian refused to do this. She said she was too busy and even shouted at me inside the clinic. I have never felt so badly treated while trying to save my cat.

According to this clinic and their hospital, my cat should already be dead. Instead of support, I experienced refusal to help and extremely unprofessional behaviour.

Because of this experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.
I wouldn't recommend this clinic to anyone. Due to a misdiagnosis, our dog died suddenly and horribly. They showed no empathy whatsoever; to them, an animal is just a number.

I am glad I have finally found an expert vet; my cat has recovered significantly. If it had been up to them, my cat would have been euthanized long ago after a super expensive dental treatment! Very incompetent, no real attention for the patient or the owner!
A great vet practice where they speak English and take excellent care of my cat.
Easily accessible with very friendly and professional staff. Consultation was good and thorough. They helped me find assistance in other places to perform exams they could not do in the facility
Very thoughtful and good with my cat

I DO NOT RECOMMEND.
My dog ​​showed aggression and they refused to perform the consultation. They told me to reschedule with a more experienced professional in aggressive dogs. However, they still wanted to charge the consultation fee, which I refused to pay. They only see money and don't really care about the animal or the owner.
It’s very good ! My dog had her vaccination here and the checkup was good ! She got treats💗💗 …
Aggressive cats apparently don't deserve treatment from them, and they can't offer any alternatives. They lack skilled doctors. Ones who don't sit there with trembling hands.
good professional help
Very good vet. Very nice and knowledgeable staff. And most importantly, very sweet with your animal.

I’ve been going to this vet for years, and they used to be okay. However, since all the old vets left and new staff took over, the quality of care has dropped drastically. The new vets are extremely unprepared, often looking up symptoms on the computer during consultations, and most of the time they don’t even do necessary blood work before surgeries requiring anesthesia. Unfortunately, there have been multiple cases of young, healthy pets dying under their care, which is also reflected in other Google reviews and is a well-known concern in my neighborhood. Many pet owners I know have stopped going here because of these dangerous and careless practices.
Each visit, there’s a different vet, so you end up repeating your pet’s medical history over and over, only to get conflicting opinions every time. It makes you lose trust in their care.
The staff is generally polite, which is the only positive I can mention, however that is not enough when your pet’s life and health are at risk.
They are very nice, and sweet to my cat.
Such lovely staff, professional and know exactly what they’re doing.

This place used to be a regular vet, but now exclusively employs very young, relatively inexperienced staff (late teens / early twenties) without the customary supervision. The quality of service unsurprisingly suffered tremendously. It feels like they were absorbed into a franchise conglomerate who cares only about the bottom line.
Whatever the reason, do yourself and especially your pet a favor and find another vet.

I recently took my Shih-Tzu, Puki, to the Pet Clinic Buitenveldert for a dental check-up, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team was professional, caring, and truly had Puki’s best interest at heart.

During the consultation, they identified a minor health issue and immediately decided to stop the planned procedure to avoid any risk. Their honesty and transparency were outstanding – it was clear they prioritize animal wellbeing over profit, which is sadly rare these days.

As a pet owner, this gave me great peace of mind. Puki was treated with genuine compassion, and I left feeling completely confident in the clinic’s judgment and values.

If you’re looking for a vet that truly puts your pet first, look no further. Pet Clinic Buitenveldert has earned my full trust – and a well-deserved 10-star review!
Thank you very much!
Thank you!
Very loving towards my Luna, it was wonderful to be with you.

1. Like another review, I also left my pomeranian here for teeth cleaning. He also had blood drawn. Upon pick up, I panicked because of all the blood and how scared my dog looked. They then cleaned and bandaged his leg with me present because they weren’t able to before…? At home, he was afraid and shaking, and wouldn’t move.

2. I called to ask about pomeranians having babies as I suspected one of mine was pregnant, and in the middle of the call, the lady says “sorry but it doesn’t seem like you know anything”. Well, of course I don’t! That’s why I’m calling. I’m not the vet. Very rude and unnecessary remark.

3. My dog’s tooth became lose. When we spoke on the phone to make an appointment, we discussed the possibility of getting it pulled out as soon as possible because he has a hard time eating and seems to be in pain. After the appointment, where they did NOT pull it out and we still paid, they said they’d email some information as to how to move forward, but it’s been over a week, and they never emailed me anything. Another vet pulled the tooth out in 5 minutes.

When I started coming here with my first dog about 4 years ago, I loved this place, but as of this year, it has become a pain to deal with them.

I went here regularly last year with my chronically ill cat and ultimately had him euthanized. Saying goodbye and the entire process with the crematorium went very professionally and smoothly. I always received serious help and assistance beforehand. I also often received advice by phone. The costs are high, but that's the case everywhere, and I think it's a shame that people give negative reviews because of that. At a previous practice, they performed unsolicited tests and there was no communication. Here, the pros and cons are thoroughly discussed first. I'm satisfied.

Great vet, but really expensive!
I received a bill of over €900 for having one tooth removed from my cat, while another vet charged €350 for the same surgery and medication.
For the exact same medication, I pay €56 per bottle here, while I can buy it from another vet for €26.
Where do these price differences come from? It's not due to quality.

You are not taken seriously, the veterinarian is poorly trained and inexperienced, and your animal is dead.

We have been coming here for years. Unfortunately, something has changed in recent years. The inexperienced and unqualified veterinarian examined our dog and assured us that the dog was okay and just needed some attention. She told us this, even though we clearly indicated that the dog was having trouble breathing and coughing, and that this was our second visit to a vet in a short time. The veterinarian did not proceed with further examination (no X-ray) against our wishes and sent us home. Two days later, our dog passed away.

We have a very, very bad feeling about how easily this all happens, that you just send a sick dog home without further examination. As an owner, you are also not taken seriously or heard while you are trying to save your animal. That is a real disgrace. We will never come back here and are considering taking this matter further before the disciplinary board/committee.
Wonderful caring people
Friendly staff. Helpful and patient.

Two years ago, the pet shop was closed so that more veterinarians could be hired to help the animals faster. For a short period, they had a team of four doctors. Unfortunately, two of them have since left, partly to set up a new branch. Now it takes well over two weeks (!!) before you can even make an appointment; even an emergency appointment can easily take two to three days. That is truly unacceptable. I am satisfied with the care itself, but I have not yet spoken to the new doctors.
Thank you for your positive review!
Thank you for your 5-star review!👍 …

I had an extremely bad experience, both in person and on the phone. It was truly disappointing that they were unable to help a kitten weighing only 3 kilos and only 1 year old with her vaccinations. Instead, I was told that a narcotic …
Thank you! 😊 …
Professional and friendly
